objective: Close the B753/B674 false-negative path: an isolated validation run's sanitized, credential-free HOME cannot import the operator-installed pytest package, so pytest-based validation commands fail with ModuleNotFoundError instead of exercising the product under test.

bug_reproduction.cause: site.getusersitepackages() under the sanitized validation HOME has no .local/lib/pythonX/site-packages of its own; the operator's real pytest install lives only under the parent host's real HOME.

fix_summary.wiring: run_validations() now checks _is_pytest_validation_command(tokens) after parse_validation_command(); when true it calls resolve_trusted_pytest_runtime_root() and prepends that exact path to the existing pythonpath_components tuple before computing validation_readonly_dirs and the child PYTHONPATH -- preserving any relative project PYTHONPATH the card already declared. Non-pytest commands take the unchanged prior code path (effective_components is exactly pythonpath_components), so their env/argv stay byte-equivalent.
fix_summary.trust_root_source: site.getusersitepackages() -- the same single canonical absolute path resolve_validation_pythonpath/_validation_pythonpath_readonly_dirs already accept as the sole approved absolute PYTHONPATH component; no new discovery mechanism, no host-path guessing.
trust_checks: reject if the raw or resolved path is a symlink (validation_pytest_runtime_symlink_forbidden)
reject if the path does not exist / is not a directory (validation_pytest_runtime_unavailable)
reject if not owned by this process's uid (validation_pytest_runtime_untrusted_owner)
reject if it does not contain an importable pytest/__init__.py (validation_pytest_runtime_missing_pytest)
fix_summary.binding: Read-only: bubblewrap --ro-bind under /validation-pythonpath/<n> via the pre-existing validation_readonly_dirs mechanism; Landlock never restricts reads (only mutation rights), so the path is inherently non-writable to the sandboxed child there too. No package files are copied; no other real-HOME content is exposed; no credentials pass through this path.
fix_summary.fail_closed: resolve_trusted_pytest_runtime_root() raises WorkspaceError before any pytest validation command's subprocess is spawned when no approved root exists; run_validations' existing scratch-dir provisioning, TMPDIR override, and finally-block cleanup (B753) are untouched.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: Reproduce python3 -m pytest import failure under the current sanitized validation HOME while parent-host pytest is installed.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: TestReproducesSanitizedHomePytestImportFailure; also directly reproduced live in this session: `python3 -m pytest -q tools/geoai-task-mcp/tests/test_validation_exec_scratch_b753_v1.py` -> `/usr/bin/python3: No module named pytest`.

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: For pytest validation only, resolve one canonical trusted Python package root, reject symlinks/untrusted ownership/world-writable paths, bind it read-only and prepend only that exact path to PYTHONPATH while preserving the card's relative project PYTHONPATH.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: resolve_trusted_pytest_runtime_root(); TestResolveTrustedPytestRuntimeRoot (symlink/owner/missing/missing-pytest cases; world-writable case environment-skipped, see note); test_pytest_command_succeeds_with_trusted_root_prepended_and_project_pythonpath_preserved (components == [trusted_root, '.']).

acceptance_mapping.acceptance: Do not copy packages, expose the real HOME, inherit credentials, add arbitrary host paths or make package roots writable. Non-pytest validation commands must keep byte-equivalent environment/path behavior.
acceptance_mapping.evidence: test_pytest_command_does_not_leak_adapter_credentials; test_non_pytest_command_env_and_argv_are_unchanged (forces resolve_trusted_pytest_runtime_root to raise AssertionError if ever called for a non-pytest command).

Use a standalone unittest-compatible regression command so this task's own validation does not depend on the bug it repairs.

skipped_test.name: TestResolveTrustedPytestRuntimeRoot.test_world_writable_root_is_rejected
skipped_test.reason: This authoring session is itself a nested Task MCP worker sandbox (Landlock + seccomp) that denies the chmod/fchmod syscalls needed to force a directory to mode 0o777 after creation, and umask strips the world-write bit at mkdir time (0o777 -> 0o775). The world-writable rejection branch (mode & 0o002) is exercised by direct code inspection and is structurally identical to the already-covered owner/symlink/missing branches; it is expected to pass in an unsandboxed coordinator process where chmod succeeds normally.
